item.title: Two graphs run my coding agents: one picks the work, one decides it is done
item.description:
The setup

Give a coding agent one task and you are supervising a tool. Give it a whole project and you have quietly taken on a second job, one that runs the entire time the agent does: keeping it pointed at the right work, and checking that the work it swears is finished actually is. Both halves are dull, both are constant, and both get worse the faster the agent gets, because a fast agent produces more than you can personally keep track of. That is the tax nobody mentions when they tell you to let the agent run.
